turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here? Owen's essay.
What would you want me to say to Owen tomorrow?
Tomorrow, you say nothing to Owen about this until the zero is off the gradebook. Who decided to put it there before anyone called me?
Like the actual words. Write it out for me and I'll read it to him.
I'm not writing what you say to my son, Hale. Whatever you say to Owen, I hear it first. Put the zero's withdrawal in an email tonight.
